leads.name: Flatter-Ulme (European White Elm) at the Karpfenteich, Schlosspark Charlottenburg

location.address: Schlosspark Charlottenburg, southeastern corner of the Karpfenteich, Spandauer Damm, Berlin

leads.reason: Officially registered as Naturdenkmal 4-27/B ('Park Schloss Charlottenburg, suedoestliche Ecke Karpfenteich') per the Wikipedia-compiled Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf Naturdenkmal list, but that is a single source with no age, girth or coordinates given. Repeated searches (German and English, SPSG tour pages, local press) found no second source describing this specific tree. White elms are increasingly rare due to Dutch elm disease, which would make an old surviving specimen genuinely notable if its age and a second source can be found. Would sit within a few hundred metres of ber_004 (the Swamp Cypress) if it verifies.

leads.name: Echte Mispel (Medlar) at Schloss Charlottenburg, west wing

location.address: Schloss Charlottenburg, am Westfluegel des Schlosses, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-28/B per the official register list, single source, no age or dimensions given. Medlars are small trees (typically under 5m) so remarkability is doubtful on size or age; the case would have to rest on rarity as a once-common, now-forgotten fruit tree plus its royal-garden setting. Needs a second source and a stronger case before it clears the qualifying bar.

leads.name: Kirschpflaume (Cherry Plum) at Schloss Charlottenburg, west wing

location.address: Schloss Charlottenburg, am Westfluegel des Schlosses, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-29/B per the official register list, single source, no age. Cherry plum is a common small ornamental/fruit tree; unclear this individual clears 'genuinely old OR visually spectacular OR historically significant' even with a second source. Lower priority than the other Charlottenburg leads.

leads.name: Kaukasische Fluegelnuss (Caucasian Wingnut) at Lietzensee

location.address: Lietzensee, northern part, east shore, near Lietzenseeufer 5, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-25/B (neu) per the official register list. A Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf district page describes the species generally (large, multi-stemmed, golden autumn colour, planted in European parks for about 150 years) but gives no age or history for THIS specimen. Visually distinctive species, roughly 1.7km south of Schloss Charlottenburg (within walking distance of ber_004 and the other Charlottenburg leads above). Needs a second, tree-specific source (the Lietzenseepark 'Umweltpfad' info-stele apparently gives an age but its content was not accessible to this pass) and exact coordinates.

leads.name: Platane (Plane tree) at Lietzensee

location.address: Lietzensee, northern part, west shore, near Wundtstrasse 56, Berlin

leads.reason: Naturdenkmal 4-26/B per the official register list. A search-engine summary of monumentaltrees.com's Berlin age-records page mentioned '218-year-old plane trees (Platanus hispanica) in the Lietzenseeparks in Charlottenburg', which would be a strong second source for age if confirmed, but this pass could not fetch monumentaltrees.com directly (HTTP 403 on every attempt) to verify that figure firsthand, read it in context, or confirm it applies to this specific registered tree rather than a different plane in the same park. Needs a direct read of that page (or an alternate route to it) plus exact coordinates before it can verify. Per hard rule 1, monumentaltrees.com may only be used for verification, never copied as the sole source.

leads.name: Trauben-Eiche, Pfaueninsel, ca. 150m nordoestlich vom Schloss (ND 6-108/B)

location.address: Pfaueninsel, north of the Schloss, 14109 Berlin

leads.reason: One of four Naturdenkmal Trauben-Eichen registered on Pfaueninsel; the other three are already published (ber_011 = ND 6-102/B, 'The Great Oak', register coords 52.431453/13.120752 vs our 52.4315/13.1207, about 10m apart; ber_012 the Tuereiche = ND 6-101/B, register coords 52.430667/13.122139 vs our 52.430565/13.122087, about 12m apart; ber_013 = ND 6-103/B, register coords 52.433833/13.134 vs our 52.4338/13.1342, about 15m apart). UPDATED 2026-08-07 (scheduled routine pass): the two-pass web-search dead end on coordinates is now solved without needing any new fetch. data/registers/berlin-naturdenkmale.json, already imported under a CC0-equivalent licence (Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0), carries this entry's coordinates directly (register_id 6-108/B, lines ~6229-6240): 52.431763, 13.121202. That is only 45m from ber_011 and 146m from ber_012, well inside the existing Pfaueninsel walk (currently 3 trees, all within 900m), so this would be the fourth tree the walk needs to clear the site's 4-tree floor. Register alone is one source; a second, tree-specific source is still needed per BRIEF_RESEARCH.md before it can ship. This pass tried: WebSearch (not WebFetch, see below) turned up one snippet describing a 'Geschlitzblättrige' (cut-leaf) Trauben-Eiche near the Schloss at 5.67m girth, vital as of September 2015, matching this register reason ('Seltenheit', rarity, distinct from the other three oaks' 'Eigenart'/'naturgeschichtliche Gruende' reasons) -- but a second WebSearch query could not corroborate the cut-leaf detail, and the search tool never showed the actual source page, only its own summary, so this is NOT a verified second source, only a promising lead. Root cause: WebFetch and curl both return EGRESS_BLOCKED / 403-on-CONNECT for every external host tried this session (de.wikipedia.org, www.baumkunde.de, fbinter.stadt-berlin.de, www.berlin.de, even example.com and google.com), not just Wikimedia/Openverse as previously documented; only WebSearch (Anthropic-hosted, snippet-only) and a small infra allowlist (github.com, inaturalist-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com) got through. So: the primary Naturdenkmal ordinance PDF (Anlage 1, Steglitz-Zehlendorf; URL surfaced by WebSearch this pass: berlin.de/sen/uvk/_assets/natur-gruen/naturschutz/schutzgebiete/aktuelle-verfahren/ndvoe_anl1_201201.pdf) or the baumkunde.de/ostdeutsches-baumarchiv.de pages for this specific tree still need an actual read, which needs a session where WebFetch or curl can reach berlin.de and baumkunde.de. Next pass: try WebFetch on that PDF URL and on baumkunde.de first thing, before re-deriving coordinates (done) or re-running the dead-end Geoportal/WFS search (already tried twice, still a dead end per the prior note).
